upcoming.emptyBody: Use Schedule to pick a time, people and guests and send invitations.

new.title: New meeting
new.slugHint: Made from the title when left empty
new.guests: Guests can join with the link
new.guestsHint: People without an account join by typing a name
new.guestsOff: Guests are off in this space · ask an admin
new.lobbyHint: Moderators let them in; when off they enter directly
new.autoRecordHint: Recording starts with the meeting and everyone is told
new.instantHint: The room opens and you go to the waiting room. Share the link to call others in.
new.instantHintSpace: Members of {name} can join this room directly.

prejoin.heading: You're about to join
prejoin.inside: {count, plural, one {# person inside} other {# people inside}}
prejoin.nobody: Nobody is here yet; you'll be the first.
prejoin.endedBody: The meeting was cancelled or its room was deleted, so you can't join again.
prejoin.chatMembersSee: Not recorded · conversation members see that you joined
prejoin.permissionBody: Allow access from the camera icon in the address bar, then reload. You can also join without it and just listen.
prejoin.insecureTitle: A secure connection is needed for camera and microphone
prejoin.insecureBody: This address (http) is not secure, so the browser keeps the camera and microphone off. Open it with localhost or an https address on this device. For now you can join to listen.

lobby.waitingBody: A moderator of {title} will let you in. Keep this tab open.
lobby.retryHint: You can ask again in a minute.

otherDevices.here: You are in this meeting now · {title}
otherDevices.movedTitle: The meeting moved to your other device
otherDevices.movedBody: You are continuing the meeting on your other device.

room.droppedBody: Your connection to the meeting broke and could not be restored. Check your internet connection and join again.
room.speaker: Speaker
room.recordingStopped: Recording stopped; the file lands in Drive when ready
room.weakBanner: Your connection is weak. Your video was lowered.
room.mediaBlockedTitle: Audio and video cannot reach the server
room.mediaBlockedBody: You are connected to the meeting, but the audio and video path did not open. A network or firewall may be blocking it (UDP 50000-60000, TCP 7881). Try another network or tell your admin; you may not hear others meanwhile.

stats.title: Connection details
stats.hint: What the browser measures for every sound and video you send and receive. Copy it into a problem report.
stats.bufferHint: Received audio: how long sound waits before it is played. Sent: how long packets wait before they go out. More than a few hundred ms means the voice is heard late.

paths.detour: audio over TCP or a relay can arrive late

verdict.ok: Your connection and computer look fine; if it still breaks up, it may be the other side or the server.
verdict.network: Network trouble: packet loss, latency or a bandwidth limit.
verdict.cpu: This computer cannot keep up: the CPU is lowering video quality. Try closing other apps or turning the camera off.
verdict.unknown: Nothing is being sent or received right now.

roomActions.name: Room name
roomActions.rotateBody: A new link is created and the old one stops working at once. Send the new one wherever you shared it.
roomActions.deleteBody: The room's link will stop working. Past meetings, recordings and summaries stay.
roomActions.endFirst: A meeting is going on in this room; end it first

meetingActions.peopleHint: People added get an invitation, people removed a cancellation.
meetingActions.wholeSeries: The change applies to the whole series.
meetingActions.saved: Meeting updated; the people were told
meetingActions.cancelBody: The people get a cancellation and a calendar cancel. The link stops working; past meetings and summaries stay.
meetingActions.endFirst: The meeting is going on now; end it first

chatJoin.live: Meeting going on · {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}

controls.shareGuest: You can share once a moderator allows it
controls.shareNotAllowed: You are not allowed to share your screen in this meeting
controls.shareAudioHint: Sends the shared tab's sound, or on Windows the whole screen's system sound. A shared window sends no sound.
controls.shareAudioNext: Sound goes out from the next share.
controls.recordModeratorOnly: A moderator can start the recording
controls.needsHttps: Camera and microphone need a secure connection (https)
controls.listenerOnly: As a viewer you cannot speak or turn on video; ask a moderator for the floor

chat.liveHint: These messages disappear when the meeting ends
chat.moduleHint: Stays in Chat as the meeting conversation afterwards

people.title: People {count}
people.mailLink: Send the invitation link by e-mail

you.mute: A moderator muted you; you can unmute yourself
you.stop_camera: A moderator turned your camera off
you.allow_screen_share: You can share your screen now
you.remove: You were removed from the meeting

record.title: Start recording?
record.where: Everyone is told "This meeting is being recorded". When it ends, the recording is saved in Drive under {name} › {folder}; space members can open it.
record.moderatorsOnly: Only moderators start and stop recordings.
record.retention: The recording goes to the trash after {days} days.
record.unavailable: Recording can't start now: the recorder is off or Drive is full.

settings.joinLeaveSound: Play a sound when someone joins or leaves
settings.shareModeHint: Text keeps documents, code and slides sharp. Video is smoother for moving content. Applies from the next share.
settings.title: Settings
settings.speaker: Speaker
settings.echoHint: You can turn it off with headphones
settings.qualityHint: Auto: the camera goes out as 3-layer simulcast
settings.dataSaverHint: Receive others' video at the lowest layer (recommended on mobile data)
settings.remoteControlHint: Someone sharing their screen from the desktop app can give mouse and keyboard control to a participant who asks

invite.title: Invite people
invite.guestLinkHint: Anyone with the link can ask to join by typing a name.
invite.lobbyHint: Guests wait until a moderator lets them in
invite.linkLifetimeHint: The link stops working when the meeting ends or the time is up
invite.rotate: New link (the old one stops working)
invite.rotated: New link copied; the old link no longer works
invite.guestsOff: Guests are off · ask a space admin.
invite.membersHint: The people you pick are called now; they join when they answer.
invite.emailHint: People without an account come with the link and are let in from the lobby.
invite.privacy: Guests don't see other conversations, Drive or people's e-mails; only this meeting.

removed.title: You were removed from the meeting
removed.body: With the same link you'll wait in the lobby; a moderator can let you back in.

notFound.title: Meeting not found
notFound.body: The link may be wrong or the meeting deleted.

spaceSettings.title: Meeting settings
spaceSettings.body: Meeting rules per space. Space admins and owners can change them.
spaceSettings.guestsHint: People without an account join with the link, through the lobby
spaceSettings.editorsRecordHint: Admins and owners can always record
spaceSettings.retentionHint: Expired recordings go to the trash and are deleted 30 days later
spaceSettings.readOnly: Only space admins can change these settings.

guestPage.permissionNote: Camera and microphone access is asked for this page only.
guestPage.waitingBodyHost: {name} or a moderator will let you in. Keep this tab open; you'll go in on your own once accepted.
guestPage.waitingBody: A moderator will let you in. Keep this tab open; you'll go in on your own once accepted.
guestPage.waitingNote: If nobody answers in 10 minutes the request drops and you can send it again.
guestPage.retryIn: You can ask again in {seconds} s.
guestPage.retryNow: You can send a new request.
guestPage.invalidTitle: This invitation is no longer valid
guestPage.invalidBody: The link may be wrong or cancelled. Ask the person who invited you.
guestPage.expiredTitle: This invitation is no longer valid
guestPage.expiredBody: The meeting is over or the link expired.
guestPage.membersOnlyTitle: This meeting is for members only
guestPage.membersOnlyBody: Sign in with your account to join.
guestPage.endedBody: The meeting was ended for everyone.
guestPage.unavailableBody: The meetings module is switched off in this workspace. Ask the person who invited you.

call.incomingInvite: {name} is calling you into a meeting

control.layer: {name}'s screen · mouse and keyboard go to this screen, Esc releases

admin.remoteControlHint: Someone sharing their screen from the desktop app can give mouse and keyboard control to a participant who asks. When off nobody can ask; a moderator can also turn it off in a meeting.

window.blocked: Allow pop-ups in your browser to open meetings in their own tab. It opened in this tab for now.
